info.name: Ayez Ahlaq — Merchant (mobile)
info.description:
Every endpoint the merchant mobile app needs, and nothing else. No admin endpoints — the admin uses the web portal.

Auth: phone number + password (same as the barber / customer apps). Self sign-up is `Auth > Register` — the account is active immediately and the response already contains a token. `Auth > Login` and `Auth > Register` both run a test script that stores `token` + `merchantId` as collection variables, so every other request is ready to fire.

Phone number: send it however the user types it — `01001234567`, `+201001234567`, `201001234567` all work. The backend strips the `+20` / `20` / leading `0` and stores the country code (`20`) and the national number (`1001234567`) separately. Responses give you `phoneNumber` (local `0…` form), `countryCode`, and `phoneE164` (`+20…`).

Base URL: production is `https://gobeeeg.com/ayezAhlaqApi`; for local use `http://localhost:8082`.

The phone can be `01001234567` / `+201001234567` / `201001234567` — it is stored as country code `20` + national `1001234567`. 409 if the phone is already taken. Response `data` = { token, role, actorId, displayName }.
Body is `phoneNumber` + `password`. Any prefix form is accepted. Token TTL 24h.
Only needed when reviving a previously self-deleted account (register then returns {activated:false, devOtp}); a brand-new phone is logged in immediately. Returns the full AuthResponse (the token).
Fresh 6-digit code (TTL 300s), attempt counter reset, previous code dead. 400 if there is no pending / un-verified signup for that number.
{ expiresInSeconds, devOtp }. Works for a barber owner AND a team member. No X-Client needed even for barber.
{ resetToken (opaque, TTL 600s), expiresInSeconds }.
Third and final step. 400 on a bad / expired reset token.
min 6 chars; wrong currentPassword -> 400. Barber: X-Client required (bare /api/{role}/password, not the /password/ prefix).

Returns businessName, ownerName, phoneNumber (local 0… form), countryCode, phoneE164, userName, email, active, mustChangePassword, `categoryLimit` (max private categories the merchant may add — set by the admin), createdAt, and the list of extra phones.

item.name: Delivery
item.description: Merchant-configurable delivery. When ON, a barber ordering with fulfillmentType=DELIVERY has `fee` added to the order total (free when the goods total reaches `freeOver`). When OFF, barbers can only pick up from the merchant.

request.description: Returns { offered, fee, freeOver }.
offered=false clears fee/freeOver. freeOver is optional (null or 0 = no free-delivery threshold).
pendingOrders, activeOrders, deliveredThisMonth, monthRevenue, productCount, liveDiscounts.

Absolute available quantity for the product. Stock lives on the product itself — there are no branches. Accepting an order deducts each item's quantity from its product; a shortfall fails the accept with 400. You can also set `stock` inside Create / Update product.
Everything a product can be tagged with: admin global catalog (`global: true`) + this merchant's own.

multipart/form-data. name required. `image` optional — if omitted the category shows the admin's global default category image. The merchant may keep at most `categoryLimit` of their own (from GET profile; the admin sets it) — 400 past the limit. Own categories are auto-renumbered to sortOrder 1..N.

First of the product's own images, else its category's image, else the global default product image. 404 only if none is configured anywhere. `ProductResponse.imageSource` (OWN / CATEGORY / DEFAULT / NONE) + `imageIds` tell you what's there.

item.name: Discounts
item.description:
Four kinds of discount, plus optional per-barbershop scoping. All under /api/merchant/discount.

`scope`:
- `PRODUCT` — % or fixed EGP off one product. Needs targetProductId. One active PRODUCT discount per product (409 otherwise).
- `BUY_X_GET_Y` — buy `buyQuantity` of targetProductId, get `rewardQuantity` of them free (rewardType FREE) or discounted (PERCENT/AMOUNT). One active per product.
- `ORDER_TOTAL` — when the order subtotal reaches `minOrderTotal`: % / EGP off the order, or a free `rewardProductId` gift. Create several for tiers — the highest threshold met wins.

`rewardType`: PERCENT (rewardValue 1-100) | AMOUNT (rewardValue EGP) | FREE (rewardProductId + rewardQuantity; not allowed for PRODUCT).

`shopIds`: omit / empty = every barbershop; list = only those. Get the ids from GET /api/merchant/discount/shop.

Active discounts can be edited in place; closed ones cannot reopen. Use POST /quote to see the math for a cart.

request.description: All discounts (active + closed), newest first. Each has a resolved `summary`, `liveNow`, and `shops` (empty = all shops).
`[{ id, name, area }]` — pick which barbershops a discount targets.

item.name: Create — PRODUCT (% or EGP off one product)

request.description: For a discounted (not free) 5th, use `"rewardType": "PERCENT", "rewardValue": 50`.
For a free gift instead: `"rewardType": "FREE", "rewardProductId": <id>, "rewardQuantity": 1`.
`shopIds` = only these barbershops see the discount. Empty/omitted = all.
Full replace of an active discount (400 if closed). Send the whole body. `shopIds` replaces the scoping set.

Runs the same engine the barber-side order will use. Returns `lines` (with split-off gift lines), `subtotal`, `orderDiscount`, `total`, and `applied` (which discounts fired). Pass `shopId` to test per-shop scoping.

query.description: optional filter. One of: PENDING, ACCEPTED, PREPARING, READY_FOR_PICKUP, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, REJECTED, CANCELLED

request.description: Orders placed by barbershops. Omit `status` for all. The `orderStatus` collection variable defaults to PENDING. Response OrderResponse now also carries `deliveryFee` (fee the barber chose for a DELIVERY order, snapshotted at creation) and `grandTotal` (= total + deliveryFee; `total` stays the goods value). An admin may cancel an order after you accepted it (stock is returned); you then see status=CANCELLED with `cancelledAt` set. The admin's reason (`cancellationNote`, `cancelledByAdminName`) is admin-only and always null in merchant responses.

Full order: items, shop, barber, fulfilmentType (DELIVERY / PICKUP_AT_BRANCH), total, `orderDiscount` (the ORDER_TOTAL reward, EGP), timestamps, and `nextStatuses` — the moves you're allowed to make now.

Each item carries the price applied at order time (`unitPrice`, `unitDiscount`, `lineTotal`, `gift`, `discountId`) AND today's live values (`currentUnitPrice`, `currentUnitDiscount`, `currentEffectivePrice`) + `priceChangedSinceOrder` — so you can show "ordered at X, now Y". `gift` lines (BUY_X free unit, ORDER_TOTAL gift) have unitDiscount == unitPrice. Response OrderResponse now also carries `deliveryFee` (fee the barber chose for a DELIVERY order, snapshotted at creation) and `grandTotal` (= total + deliveryFee; `total` stays the goods value). An admin may cancel an order after you accepted it (stock is returned); you then see status=CANCELLED with `cancelledAt` set. The admin's reason (`cancellationNote`, `cancelledByAdminName`) is admin-only and always null in merchant responses.

Deducts each item's quantity from its product's stock. 400 if any product is short. Response OrderResponse now also carries `deliveryFee` (fee the barber chose for a DELIVERY order, snapshotted at creation) and `grandTotal` (= total + deliveryFee; `total` stays the goods value). An admin may cancel an order after you accepted it (stock is returned); you then see status=CANCELLED with `cancelledAt` set. The admin's reason (`cancellationNote`, `cancelledByAdminName`) is admin-only and always null in merchant responses.

reason required. Response OrderResponse now also carries `deliveryFee` (fee the barber chose for a DELIVERY order, snapshotted at creation) and `grandTotal` (= total + deliveryFee; `total` stays the goods value). An admin may cancel an order after you accepted it (stock is returned); you then see status=CANCELLED with `cancelledAt` set. The admin's reason (`cancellationNote`, `cancelledByAdminName`) is admin-only and always null in merchant responses.

The full status set (also the values accepted by `GET /order?status=`):

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| PENDING | just placed, waiting on you |
| ACCEPTED | you accepted; product stock deducted |
| PREPARING | picking / packing |
| READY_FOR_PICKUP | ready for pickup (PICKUP orders) |
| OUT_FOR_DELIVERY | courier on the way (DELIVERY orders) |
| DELIVERED | handed over — terminal |
| REJECTED | you rejected with a reason — terminal |
| CANCELLED | cancelled by the barbershop — terminal |

This endpoint only makes FORWARD moves: ACCEPTED→PREPARING, PREPARING→READY_FOR_PICKUP | OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, READY_FOR_PICKUP | OUT_FOR_DELIVERY→DELIVERED. Leaving PENDING is done with Accept / Reject. Each order's `nextStatuses` array lists exactly what it will accept right now. Set the `orderStatus` collection variable, or use the ready-made requests below. Response OrderResponse now also carries `deliveryFee` (fee the barber chose for a DELIVERY order, snapshotted at creation) and `grandTotal` (= total + deliveryFee; `total` stays the goods value). An admin may cancel an order after you accepted it (stock is returned); you then see status=CANCELLED with `cancelledAt` set. The admin's reason (`cancellationNote`, `cancelledByAdminName`) is admin-only and always null in merchant responses.

The admin-managed numbers you transfer the money TO (InstaPay / Vodafone Cash / …). Returns active ones only: [{ id, type, mobileNumber, label }]. Show these as a dropdown on the DEPOSIT screen — the user picks one, you send its id as transferAccountId below.

Optional — ONE image or PDF, ≤ 15 MB (transfer screenshot / bank slip).

request.description: multipart/form-data. Creates a PENDING request. One pending per owner at a time (409). **transferAccountId is required for BOTH DEPOSIT and WITHDRAW** — it is the admin-managed InstaPay / Vodafone Cash account from GET /transferAccount, and it is what tells the admin which method to use. On WITHDRAW put the merchant's own receiving number in `note`. WITHDRAW is capped at the wallet's available balance. The admin approves (credits/debits the wallet) or rejects with a reason; you get a notification.
404 if the request has no attachment.
PENDING → CANCELLED.

Sends a notification to barber shops. scope: ALL (every shop) | ZONE (shops in your auto-detected service zone). NOT sent immediately — it enters the admin approval queue as status=PENDING (recipientCount 0, no quota spent). The admin may edit the title/body, then approve (quota is spent + delivered) or reject with a reason. You get a notification either way (type broadcast_approved / broadcast_rejected). ZONE with no location set / outside every zone → 400.
Each: { id, scope, title, body, status (PENDING|APPROVED|REJECTED), recipientCount, decisionNote, decidedAt, sentAt, createdAt }.
